    input rst,
    input sin,

);

            pout <= {pout[6:0], sin};
        end
    end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input areset,
  input train_valid,
  input train_taken,
  output logic [1:0] state
);

  always_ff @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
    if (areset) begin
      state <= 2'b00;
    end else begin
      if (train_valid) begin
        if (train_taken) begin
          state <= 2'b01;
        end else begin
          state <= 2'b10;
        end
      end
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input j,
  input k,
  input reset,
  output reg out
);

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin
      out <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      case ({j, k})
        2'b00: out <= out;     // No change
        2'b01: out <= 1'b0;    // Reset
        2'b10: out <= 1'b1;    // Set
        2'b11: out <= ~out;    // Toggle
      endcase
    end
  end

endmodule

module counter_12 
(
  input rst_n,
  input clk,
  input valid_count,

  output reg [3:0] out
);

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      out <= 4'd0;
    end else if (valid_count) begin
      if (out == 4'd11) begin
        out <= 4'd0;
      end else begin
        out <= out + 1'b1;
      end
    end
  end

endmodule
